### Added
- **`components.substrate{,-crds}.versionRange` is `>=1.2.0 <1.3.0`: the Substrate line's 1.2.0 takes `substrate.atenetEgress.upstreamTrust.caBundle`** (giantswarm/agentlab#284). The egress gateway dials an actor's upstream with its image's public roots only, so a model or tool endpoint behind a private CA answered every call with `503` (`invalid peer certificate: UnknownIssuer`). With a PEM bundle in `caBundle`, the gateway trusts the public roots plus the bundle (giantswarm/substrate#92). Empty, the default, the egress gateway renders unchanged. 1.2.0 also carries otlploggrpc v0.21.0 for GO-2026-6508 (giantswarm/substrate#93) and keeps the durable pause copy out of `external_snapshot` (giantswarm/substrate#90). It is a patch of the line on kagent-dev/substrate v0.2.0-beta5, released as a minor, so the next re-pin is 1.3.0. The kagent WorkerPool's worker image follows the floor to `ateom-gvisor:1.2.0`.
